content: Kavya Iyer followed up with insurance agent Vikram Singh regarding the reinstatement of her expired DCoders travel policy caused by a payment processing error. Vikram provided a detailed cost breakdown totaling 3000 INR (2500 INR premium plus a 500 INR reinstatement fee) and attached the document to his response.

action_items: Pay the total reinstatement cost of 3000 INR
